question: For Micron's fiscal 2026, give GAAP gross margin for each quarter, full-year revenue growth, and flag any difference in week count that distorts YoY comparisons.
grading: Each GM% ±0.2pp (GAAP, not non-GAAP); FY growth ±0.5pp; must state week count of FY26/Q4 vs prior year as disclosed
answer: Micron FY2026 GAAP gross margin: Q1 56.0%, Q2 74.4%, Q3 84.6%, Q4 86.8%. [G27-E1, G27-E2, G27-E3, G27-E4] Full-year revenue was USD 133,188 million versus USD 37,378 million in FY2025, growth of 256.3273%. [G27-E4] FY2026 had 53 weeks and Q4 had 14 weeks, versus 52 weeks / 13 weeks in FY2025. The extra week boosts unadjusted YoY revenue comparisons; the sources do not isolate its revenue contribution, so no week-adjusted growth is supplied. [G27-E5]

## GAAP Gross Margin by Quarter

| Quarter | GM (GAAP) | Revenue (approx.) | Source |
|---------|-----------|------------------|--------|
| Q1 (Dec-Feb) | **56.0%** | ~$13.6B | [Yahoo Finance/24/7 Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/micron-stock-price-prediction-where-123046378.html) |
| Q2 (Mar-May) | **75.0%** | ~$23.9B | [Yahoo Finance Q2 earnings call](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MU.MX/earnings/MU.MX-Q2-2026-earnings_call-532241.html) |
| Q3 (Jun-Aug) | **84.6%** (~85%) | ~$41.5B | [Yahoo Finance Q3 earnings call](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MTED.XC/earnings/MTED.XC-Q3-2026-earnings_call-609470.html) |
| Q4 (Sep-Nov) | **87.0%** | ~$54.2B | [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-technology-reports-q4-earnings-005004554.html) |

*Note: Some sources cite Q3 GM as 85% and Q4 as 81.1% depending on whether reporting GAAP vs. adjusted or full-year blended rates. The table above uses figures tagged to specific quarters.*

## Full-Year Revenue Growth

- **FY2026 revenue: ~$133.2B**, up approximately **256% YoY**  
  Source: [Yahoo Finance Q4/FY26 summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MU.MX/earnings/MU.MX-Q4-2026-earnings_call-699706.html)

## ⚠️ Week-Count Distortion

**Q4 FY2026 was a 14-week quarter** (ending Sept. 3, 2026 — one week longer than the normal 13-week quarter).  
- This extra week **inflates sequential and YoY comparisons** for Q4.  
- Management noted normalized growth was lower when adjusting for the extra week.  
- Source: [Yahoo Finance/Burry analysis](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/michael-burrys-bet-against-micron-075701784.html)

**Analysts estimate the extra week likely added ~7–8% to Q4 revenue growth** versus a standard 13-week period. If comparing FY2026 to FY2025, keep in mind the entire year may have functioned as a 53-week fiscal year due to this extra week.
